clue.text: One lacking a blooming partner?

parts.note: a shy person left at the side of a dance without a partner, with 'blooming' hinting at a garden flower

explanation.surface: Someone without a darned partner, as a mild British curse puts it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blooming' reads as the mild British swear word, but it also points to the flower that shares the name of the person left unpartnered at a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who sits out every dance for want of a partner is called by the name of a spring garden flower.

clue.text: A poor actor turned nurse

indicators.note: turned means the word for a poor actor is read backwards

parts.note: a ham is a bad, overacting performer

explanation.surface: A failed performer changes career and takes up nursing.
explanation.definitionFit: An amah is a nursemaid or maid in parts of Asia.

clue.text: Holidays that fall in the autumn?

explanation.surface: Breaks that come around in the autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave is time off work, plural for holidays; a tree's foliage drops in the autumn.

clue.text: Pays a brief visit to watch over transgression

indicators.note: in a down clue the first word sits over the second, so they are joined in that order

parts.note: to watch is to look
a sin is a moral transgression

explanation.surface: Someone calls round to keep an eye on wrongdoing.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop in on someone for a short call is idiomatic for visiting briefly.

clue.text: Complain when I get involved with the law

indicators.note: the letter I mixes with the word law, the letters becoming jumbled together

explanation.surface: Grumbling whenever you have dealings with the police or courts.
explanation.definitionFit: To wail is to lament or moan loudly, a strong form of grumbling.

clue.text: A walker or a climber, perhaps

explanation.surface: Someone who hikes, or perhaps one who scales rock faces.
explanation.definitionFit: A hiker in the countryside, and a climbing rose that scrambles up walls and trellises.

clue.text: Stock answer given by Solomon in classic dilemma

definitions.text: answer given by Solomon in classic dilemma

explanation.surface: A wise king's verdict when two women both claimed one baby.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible, King Solomon proposed dividing a disputed baby between two mothers; 'issue' means offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: A company's offer of new shares to investors is stock; dividing the child, or offspring, was Solomon's proposal.

clue.text: Set meal and free bed at hotel

indicators.note: free signals the letters of these three words are let loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: A fixed-price dinner and a complimentary room at a hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: A French term for a fixed menu at a set price, as opposed to à la carte.

clue.text: A word of thanks he included for a goddess

indicators.note: included means one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: ta is a British informal way to say thank you
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone gets a brief thank-you note on behalf of a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: Thea, or Theia, is a Titan in Greek myth, mother of the sun and moon.

clue.text: Maybe Rumania's about to become a health resort

indicators.note: about signals the letters are turned round and rearranged

parts.note: the old spelling of Romania, here with its S kept as a letter

explanation.surface: Perhaps the Balkan country is on the point of becoming a spa.
explanation.definitionFit: A sanatorium is an institution for convalescents, historically a health retreat.

clue.text: A gunsmith will add it to his stock

definitions.text: A gunsmith will add it to his stock

parts.words: A gunsmith will add it to his stock
parts.note: stock reads as inventory, but it is the wooden butt of a gun, to which the gun's tube is fitted

explanation.surface: A gun dealer topping up his inventory.
explanation.definitionFit: The tube of a firearm is fitted to the wooden stock when a gun is assembled.

clue.text: The fighter's craft

parts.note: craft reads as skill, but here means a vessel used for fighting at sea

explanation.surface: A boxer's skill in the ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A naval vessel armed for combat is a vessel built for fighting.

clue.text: Employee who makes a packet for his colleagues

definitions.text: Employee who makes a packet for his colleagues

parts.words: Employee who makes a packet for his colleagues
parts.note: making a packet suggests earning a fortune, but here it is literally making up pay envelopes for staff

explanation.surface: A worker who earns a fortune on behalf of fellow staff.
explanation.definitionFit: An office worker who made up the weekly pay packets in cash for staff.

clue.text: Introduces off cuts

indicators.note: off signals the letters of the word are disordered and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone presents leftover pieces of meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuts in price or quantity are decreases.

clue.text: Evita became powerful by getting on

parts.note: per is Latin for by, as in per annum
taken as written

explanation.surface: Eva Duarte rose to power by advancing herself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Became powerful' and 'getting' are padding in the surface story: Eva Perón rose through her marriage to Juan Perón.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita was the popular name of Eva Perón, wife of the Argentine president.

clue.text: Cancel order to sift cinders

indicators.note: sifting the word cinders puts its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A command to sieve the ashes is revoked.
explanation.definitionFit: To rescind a law or decision is to revoke it.

clue.text: Gathers in spare parts

indicators.note: parts suggests the word spare is broken up and its letters regrouped

explanation.surface: Collects spare components.
explanation.definitionFit: To reap is to harvest a crop, bringing it in from the field.

clue.text: Service set back about female entry? Not at all

indicators.note: about means the reversed letters go round the other piece
set back means the service abbreviation is written backwards

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy, one of the armed services
Eve was the first woman to enter the world in Genesis

explanation.surface: A church service postponed over a woman's arrival? Certainly not.
explanation.definitionFit: Never means at no time, an emphatic refusal.

clue.text: They're very high in theatrical circles

definitions.text: They're very high in theatrical circles

parts.words: They're very high in theatrical circles
parts.note: circles here are theatre balconies, and the highest gallery has a heavenly name

explanation.surface: Big stars in the acting world.
explanation.definitionFit: The top gallery of a theatre is traditionally named after deities.

clue.text: Go slow going round the capital

indicators.note: the words go slow wrap round the answer's letters inside them

explanation.surface: An industrial protest slowing work around the capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: Army group threshing crops

indicators.note: threshing beats the word crops about, scattering its letters

explanation.surface: A regiment helping with the harvest.
explanation.definitionFit: A corps is a military unit made up of divisions.

clue.text: Change the law!

explanation.surface: A rallying cry to reform the legal system.
explanation.definitionFit: Small coins in your pocket, and British slang for police officers.

clue.text: She is given two articles set in a case

parts.note: taken as written
a is the indefinite article and the is the definite article
a is the indefinite article and the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A woman is handed a pair of items placed in a box.
explanation.definitionFit: To sheathe a sword or knife is to put it into its scabbard.

clue.text: Notices faulty part

indicators.note: faulty implies the word notices is wrongly assembled, letters shuffled

explanation.surface: Defective signs.
explanation.definitionFit: A section is a portion or segment of something.

clue.text: Use they put to the rest

indicators.note: put suggests the letters are placed in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: They applied something to good use.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal word for sleep, a period of resting.

clue.text: An open-air practice?

parts.note: an outdoor rehearsal, read as an attempt made outside

explanation.surface: A training session held outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: A trial run or test session, playfully read as an attempt outdoors.

clue.text: Ill stored

explanation.surface: Sick and put away.
explanation.definitionFit: Confined to bed with sickness, and put aside for later use.

clue.text: Bring ship round in river

explanation.surface: Turning a vessel about in a waterway.
explanation.walkthrough: The Wear is a river in north-east England, flowing through Durham and Sunderland.
explanation.definitionFit: A sailing term for turning a ship by swinging its stern to the wind, and a river in Durham.

clue.text: Canteen stew?

explanation.surface: A dining hall offering a hotpot.
explanation.definitionFit: A military dining hall, and a muddle or plight, with stew in its sense of a fluster.

clue.text: Fabricated steel-cored conductors of current

indicators.note: fabricated means made up, so the letters of steel-cored are rebuilt

explanation.surface: Wires made with a metal centre that carry electricity.
explanation.definitionFit: Electrodes are terminals through which current enters or leaves a device.

clue.text: Called for an orange, peeled?

indicators.note: peeled strips the outer skin, here the first and last letters of the fruit's name

explanation.surface: Telephoned to order some citrus fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Rang means telephoned, past tense of ring.

clue.text: The shooting of an unknown person?

definitions.text: The shooting of an unknown person?

parts.words: The shooting of an unknown person?
parts.note: shooting reads as a gun crime, but means filming a newcomer to see whether they suit a role

explanation.surface: A mysterious killing of someone unidentified.
explanation.definitionFit: A filmed audition used to judge whether a newcomer suits a movie role.
